entities.name: Ludwik Synowiec
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwik Synowiec was a Polish ice hockey player. He played for the Poland men's national ice hockey team at the 1980 Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, and the 1984 Winter Olympics in Sarajevo.
